findings.subject: Government
findings.concept: A successful vote of no confidence shows the government has lost legislative support
findings.question_a: A successful motion of no confidence in a parliamentary system usually indicates that:
options_a: The government has lost the confidence of the legislature
findings.question_b: What is the main purpose of a vote of no confidence in a parliamentary system?
options_b: To show that the legislature no longer supports the government
To appoint the head of state directly
findings.reason: Both ask what a successful no-confidence motion means: the government no longer commands the legislature's support.
